run_TwoPointsDE_optimizer: run a TwoPointsDE optimizer to minimize a function over 3 dimensions with 500 evaluations
create_objective_function: create a function that computes the sum of squared differences from a target value
minimize_with_nevergrad: minimize an objective function using nevergrad's TwoPointsDE optimizer and 500 budget
access_optimization_curve: access the optimization curve property after running minimize to inspect convergence progress
print_optim_curve: print the optimization curve data to stdout after completing the minimization
